title: Petricite Monument (plain Gear, no [Equip]/Equipment subtype) is offered an `equipCard` move and the engine accepts it, attaching the Monument to a friendly unit for free.
expected: equipCard enumerator (equipment.ts:92-96) and condition (equipment.ts:145) gate only on `cardType === "equipment" || cardType === "gear"` — no Equipment subtype/tag/Equip-keyword check. Petricite Monument (riftbound-cards/src/cards/sfd/petricite-monument.ts) is `cardType: "gear"` with no Equip, so it passes both filters; reducer (196-218) then sets attachedTo/equippedWith with no cost charged (comment at line 61 admits Equip cost not charged). Bug reproduced by code inspection.
observed: moves list contained equipCard {equipmentId: ...sfd-104-221, unitId: Flame Chompers}; executing it returned success and state showed Monument meta.attachedTo=<unit>, unit meta.equippedWith=[Monument], no cost paid.

history.note: fix written (isAttachable: gear needs printed [Equip]) + regression test in sfd-104-221.test.ts, both green locally, but cannot land: working-tree equipment.ts carries another lane's uncommitted equip-cost patch (imports printedEquipCost/canPayOptInCost, not exported at HEAD) -> 569 module errors on clean HEAD.
